{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.\n\nShades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.\n\nI set all of it up once and it has run every night since. {"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.\n\nEach year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.\n\nOn a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.\n\nSave this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.\n\n#iphone18pro #iphone17pro #appleevent #cameracomparison #techreview","likes":128,"comments":15,"photoCount":0,"videoCoverCount":1}

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.\n\nShades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.\n\nI set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.\n\nSave this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.\n\n#smarthome #homeautomation #hometel #eightsleep #sleeproutine","likes":76411,"comments":366,"photoCount":0,"videoCoverCount":1}

PUBLIC Hotel in SoHo if you want the most aesthetic room of the four, plus the best rooftop in the neighborhood. Arlo Midtown for the Arlo Suite terrace with three landmarks in one view. {"caption":"Planning a holiday trip to Manhattan? Here are my top 4 hotels in the two best neighborhoods to stay in.\n\nIn midtown, the Arlo Midtown is my 4 star pick, and the Arlo Suite comes with the largest outdoor terrace I have ever had at a hotel, with views of the Empire State Building, World Trade Center, and Hudson Yards from one spot. My 5 star pick is the Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards, where you get complimentary access to the largest Equinox ever built at 60,000 square feet. Ask for the Deluxe One Bedroom Suite.\n\nDown in SoHo, the Arlo SoHo is the fun one with constant rooftop events, and the City Terrace room gets you private outdoor space. The rooms do not come with a TV, but ask for one and it arrives in a suitcase.\n\nUse code TYLERLCRAWFORD for up to 40% off at Arlo. {"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.\n\nEach year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.\n\nOn a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.\n\nSave this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.\n\n#iphone18pro #iphone17pro #appleevent #cameracomparison #techreview","likes":128,"comments":15,"photoCount":0,"videoCoverCount":1}

{"caption":"The iPhone Duo is a 5.4 inch phone closed and a 7.6 inch screen open, 50 percent bigger than the 18 Pro Max. That’s $1,998. The Duo is $1,999. Apple priced it one dollar above buying both, so this isn’t a price decision, it’s whether you want one device or two.\n\nTwo things I have opinions on: Touch ID instead of Face ID on a two thousand dollar phone, and the Pencil support not shipping until later this year.
